--- play simulation, 20000 trials ---
  line                                           on play   on draw  baseline(any N on TN)
  Counterspell T2                                  63.5%     68.8%      94.1% / 96.4%
  An Offer You Can't Refuse T1                     71.5%     74.7%      97.2% / 98.2%
  Memory T6                                        81.2%     87.6%      84.8% / 90.5%
  Birds of Paradise T1                             73.1%     77.0%      97.2% / 98.2%
  Dark Ritual T1                                   74.9%     78.1%      97.2% / 98.2%
  Muldrotha, the Gravetide on curve                83.9%     89.9%      84.8% / 90.5%

  Diagnosis: a line CLOSE to its baseline is a QUANTITY problem (no land swap will help).
  A line FAR BELOW its baseline is a COLOUR problem (a filter land for that pip is the answer).
